selected_evidence.requirement: Rotate daily and retain seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: The installed policy specifies daily rotation, seven retained archives, and compression. Forced rotation produced a valid `.gz` archive, with logrotate reporting rotateCount 7.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application can continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A writer held the active log open across rotation. `copytruncate` preserved inode 256035, archived the earlier record, and the same writer successfully appended afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were identical before and after configuration and reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID was a59a9d9a-a5e0-44f7-9ca1-7f28483971e0; the safe reboot was acknowledged and unavailability observed; recovered boot ID was 3f9b54a4-19e0-40c9-a974-3bc7d9f4277c. System state, cron, policy, active data, and compressed archive were healthy after restart.
